title: Why Demodesk Isn't a Bot: All-Channel Capture Beyond Zoom
summary: Granola and Fathom are video-only notetakers. Demodesk captures video, phone, dialer, in-person, and field sales into one record. Here's why that matters.
body_markdown:
Most AI meeting assistants are bots that join Zoom calls. A conversation on a phone, in a car, at a trade show, or on a dialer never gets captured. Demodesk captures every channel — video calls, phone calls through your dialer, in-person meetings via mobile app, VOIP calls via desktop app, and uploaded recordings via API — into one permissioned, company-wide record. For sales teams that sell beyond the Zoom window, that's the difference between a partial record and a complete one.


## The problem with bot-only notetakers


Granola, Fathom, tl;dv, and most other AI notetakers capture one channel: the video meeting. They work by joining the call as a visible bot or — in Granola's case — capturing laptop audio locally while the user remembers to press start.


Both approaches break for sales teams.


**Phone calls don't get captured.** If your SDRs cold-call from Aircall or your AEs run discovery on CloudCall, a bot-only notetaker sees none of it.


**In-person meetings are invisible.** Field sales, trade shows, customer dinners, on-site workshops — the moments where enterprise deals get made leave no record.


**Field sales teams get nothing.** Reps in cars, at job sites, or in retail stores can't open a laptop to summon a Zoom bot.


**Non-standard VOIP calls disappear.** On Sipgate, a desktop softphone, or any dialer without native integration, the bot can't follow.


**Capture depends on the user.** Granola requires each user to press start per meeting. Miss it once and that conversation never enters the record.


Your "complete" conversation record is only the slice that happened in a Zoom window with a bot invited and the user paying attention. Phone, dialer, and in-person conversations never enter it.


## How Demodesk captures every channel


Demodesk is an all-channel capture layer, not a video bot. Five capture paths feed one record:


Channel How it's captured


**Online meetings** (Zoom, Teams, Google Meet) Demodesk Notetaker joins the call


**Phone & dialer calls** Native integrations with Aircall, CloudCall, Zoom Phone, RingCentral, Dialpad, Outreach, Salesloft


**In-person meetings** Demodesk Mobile App (iOS/Android) — rep hits record, mobile mic captures the conversation


**Field sales** Mobile App with after-meeting site reports — works offline, syncs when connected


**Desktop VOIP calls** Demodesk Desktop App captures system audio for softphone calls on providers without native integration


**Any other source** External recording upload API — import audio from Sipgate, custom telephony, Zapier, Make, or custom scripts


Every capture flows into the same conversation record. The same AI Assistant generates summaries and follow-up drafts. The same AI Coach scores against your scorecard. The same AI CRM Concierge updates Salesforce, HubSpot, or Pipedrive. The channel doesn't change what happens after.


## Why this matters: three scenarios


### Scenario 1: Inside sales team on Aircall


An SDR team runs 40 outbound calls a day through Aircall. With Granola, zero of those calls get captured — the entire top of funnel is invisible to coaching and CRM automation.


With Demodesk's Aircall integration, every call is recorded, transcribed, scored against the SDR scorecard, and the next-step fields are written to HubSpot. Managers coach from real objection patterns across hundreds of calls per week, not from the handful of discovery meetings that happened on Zoom.


### Scenario 2: Field sales at a construction materials company


Account managers spend three days a week on job sites. Visits happen in portacabins and parking lots. No laptop, no Zoom, no bot.


With the Demodesk Mobile App, reps hit record when the visit starts. The AI generates a site visit report, drafts a follow-up email, and updates the opportunity in Salesforce before the rep is back in the truck. The field motion gets the same conversation infrastructure as the inside team.


### Scenario 3: Enterprise AE on a non-standard dialer


An enterprise AE runs discovery calls on Sipgate. Granola can't join. Fathom can't join. Zoom notetakers are irrelevant.


With Demodesk's external recording upload API, the Sipgate recording is pushed into Demodesk via a Zapier flow. The AE gets a transcript, a MEDDIC score, and CRM updates — same as a colleague on Zoom Phone.


## The compliance side nobody talks about


Capture-per-user tools shift consent and retention responsibility to each individual rep. Granola stores all data on US AWS with no EU residency option, per their own documentation. Consent is "the user's responsibility" — meaning your DPO's responsibility is to hope every rep handles it correctly.


Demodesk is built for companies, not individuals:


- **EU-only data residency** (Azure Frankfurt), ISO 27001:2022 certified, GDPR-native architecture
- **Configurable retention** per company — 12 hours, 15, 30, 60, 90, 150 days, or 1 year
- **Bookmarked recordings** excluded from auto-deletion, enabling "delete by default, selectively retain for coaching" — the model DPOs and works councils approve
- **Consent flows** built into the product, not left to each rep
- **Your data never trains our AI**


When conversations are captured across every channel under one policy, your DPO gives one answer about where data lives and how long it's kept. When capture is per-user on a personal notetaker, that answer gets complicated fast.


## Not just recording — what happens next


All-channel capture matters because of what Demodesk does with the record. Every captured conversation, regardless of channel, feeds the same action layer:


- **AI Assistant** — summaries and follow-up email drafts on every call, Ask AI on single conversations, 98 languages
- **AI Coach** — instant post-call scoring against custom scorecards (MEDDIC, BANT, Challenger, or your own)
- **AI CRM Concierge** — writes to Salesforce, HubSpot, or Pipedrive with 99% accuracy, approval before push
- **AI Deal Insights** — flags deal risk and alerts based on what was said across the channel mix
- **AI Analyst** — answers any question across all your sales data, no dashboard hunting


A bot-only notetaker that transcribed every Zoom call would still leave the majority of a field-heavy team's pipeline invisible. All-channel capture makes the AI layer useful because it sees the real conversation.


## When a bot-only notetaker is enough


If your entire sales motion happens on Zoom and your team runs inbound demos, Granola or Fathom will cover it. The gap opens when:


- You have an outbound SDR team on a dialer
- Any portion of your revenue comes from field sales or in-person meetings
- Your telephony stack includes anything beyond Zoom Phone
- You've grown past the point where "the user remembers to press start" is a reliable company policy
- Your DPO or works council has questions about where data is stored and for how long
- You want coaching and CRM automation on every conversation, not just the ones in a Zoom window
